messages:
sara: Heads-up: rolling out the new usage-band pricing matrix next week. Draft PR is up with scenarios. Need quick ops + billing alignment.

ben: summary of change? are we adding a new high-usage band or changing breakpoints?

sara: both — new band (1M+ tokens) at $0.0006/token and breakpoint shifts at 100k and 500k. Also adding a small vendor credit for integrated partners for first 3 billing cycles.

oliver: please confirm grandfathering rules. We don't want to surprise customers mid-cycle.

sara: plan is pro rata on current invoice period, then preserve current per-unit price for 90 days (not 180) for accounts with >12 months tenure. Newer accounts move immediately. Rationale: shorter preservation window to limit long tail.

ben: can we make that configurable by cohort? some strategic accounts should get 180 days.

sara: yes — cohort override exists. ops config snippet in PR.

billing-bot: migration-estimator: estimated accounts affected by immediate move: 8,600. Estimated monthly revenue shift +/- 2.7%. Dry-run command: `./bin/price_migrate --cohort=band-shift --dry-run`.

oliver: QA checklist requests:
- invoice preview for top 200 accounts by ARR
- negative-charge guard to block credits exceeding invoice line totals
- reconciliation report WRT partner credits

ben: add me to the preview list. Also add a check to ensure reserved capacity SKUs are billed separately and not double-discounted.

sara: agreed, reserved SKUs excluded by default. I'll add a flag explicit: `--exclude-reserved`.

tess: rollout window suggestion: Sun 04:00 UTC, low traffic. Ops please confirm rate limit for migration (we had DB contention last time).

oliver: ops rec: 150 accounts/minute, run in parallel waves of 10, monitor `invoice_diff` metric. If error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, pause.

ben: finance needs a small control cohort for A/B analysis — 1% kept on old pricing for 60 days to measure churn/usage impact. Don't include reseller partners in that cohort.

sara: noted. I'll tag cohort: `control-v1` and exclude resellers.

legal-bot: automated check: partner credit wording flagged for refund liability language. @sara please update terms language to clarify credits are non-refundable and expire after 180 days.

sara: done, pushed wording update.

oliver: can we validate invoices with a script before sending? I propose: generate preview invoices, run `./scripts/invoice_diff --threshold=50` and fail if any account delta > $50.

tess: ops will run staging dry-run Fri 22:00 UTC and attach diff CSV to the PR. I'll also ask SRE to increase DB connection pool for the job.

ben: approval flow: finance approves on green diff and < $500 net exposure on canary. If canary passes, go to ramp 5x every 20m. If any invoice diffs > $200 in a batch, abort.

sara: action items:
- @tess run staging dry-run Fri 22:00 UTC and upload results to PR
- @ben produce top-200 invoice preview by Thu 18:00
- @oliver implement negative-charge guard and threshold script
- @sara tag control cohort and push final ops config

billing-bot: staging dry-run scheduled.

ben: OK. Finance tentatively green pending diffs. Will sign off after Thu previews.

sara: thanks all. Will loop in CS on outbound comms for impacted customers and post a short FAQ. :white_check_mark:
